description: Closed set of formula objects. A value is a number or { f: <op>, ... }. No strings are parsed.

flooring.scalar: Modifier calculations and formulas declaring numeric: scalar preserve fractions using evaluateRaw; default quantity formulas retain final flooring.
flooring.rule: The final result of every evaluation is floored once toward negative infinity (Math.floor).
flooring.clamps: Any node may carry min and max. They apply to that node's raw value before the final floor.
flooring.exception: stacks with per floors the division at once (whole groups of per).
flooring.traitBonus: Floors its base first, then applies a + max(floor(a * pct), 1) for a > 0; other values are unchanged.

of.meaning: Entity reference read by the op. allEnemies is a group and is valid only for stacks, which sums over the group.

missingMana.result: max(0, maxMana - mana), absent fields read as 0

stacks.result: total stacks of the status on the entity (or group); with per, floor(total / per)

energySpent.result: energySpent from the context * per; 0 when absent

cardsPlayedThisTurn.result: cardsPlayedThisTurn from the context * per; 0 when absent

fields.statuses: array of status ids, for the status metrics

traitBonus.result: base + max(floor(base * pct), 1) for base > 0, else base

context.entities: Map of entity ref to { hp, maxHp, block, mana, maxMana, statuses: { id: { stacks } } }.
